text:
maya: Heads-up — VaultForge partner wants coordinated marketplace listing + joint press. They need SSO (SAML/Okta), SCIM provisioning, and KMS/HSM BYOK integration tested. Can we do a quick sync on timelines?

aditya: Ok. SAML SSO is near-done (IdP metadata exchange + tests). SCIM has a couple of attribute mapping gaps (groups, title). KMS BYOK (PKCS#11) needs cert rotation doc + compatibility test with their HSM firmware v2.4.

liz: From product side, we need to surface a marketplace toggle for 'managed keys' vs 'customer BYOK'. Also add notes in SDK release about key formats.

tim: Infra note — private deploy + VPC peering for their SI partner demo will need a NAT rule update and ephemeral VPN creds. Demo env can reuse staging-3; I can stand up a dedicated demo cluster if needed.

sophie: Marketing: proposed embargo date 2025-02-12. Need final approved integration matrix and logos by 2025-01-29. Also want a joint explainer doc + 2-min video.

maya: Action items: 
- aditya: finish SCIM attribute map + run SCIM end-to-end with VaultForge test tenant (target 2025-01-22) 
- tim: prep staging demo cluster + VPN + sample data (target 2025-01-24) 
- liz: PR for marketplace toggle and SDK note (draft by 2025-01-20) 
- sophie: draft embargo timeline + partner liaison contact sheet (2025-01-17)

aditya: Sharing the quick SCIM curl test we used against their test tenant: 
```
curl -X POST "https://scim.vaultforge.test/Users" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"userName":"jdoe","name":{"givenName":"John","familyName":"Doe"}}'
```
I also added a small script to translate their group schema -> our claims, will push to repo.

tim: For BYOK HSM test, remind me the PKCS#11 lib path they expect? last time it was /opt/hsm/lib/libpkcs11.so. Sophie — can you confirm partner will allow us access to an HSM in their lab for the validation window? :eyes: 

sophie: Reaching out to VaultForge PM now, they said yes to lab access for two weeks starting 2025-01-27, and they'll provide a partner test key. I'll drop the contact in the thread when I have it. :thumbsup: 

maya: Nice. Also need legal to sign a joint announcement NDA — @liz can you loop in legal? We should avoid public benchmarks in the announcement.

liz: Yep, will ping legal and draft a short SLA appendix for the marketplace listing.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging-3-demo cluster provisioning queued for 2025-01-23 02:00 UTC.

maya: OK team — let's do a 20-min sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to walk gaps and confirm dates. If you can't make it, drop updates here. Thanks! :sparkles:
